text: A tender package including all technical requirements, material and labour for the Fire Alarm and Sprinkler Upgrades was prepared by Morrison Hershfield Limited, as previously approved by the Toronto Parking Authority Board (Minute No. 17-076, May 29, 2017). Morrison Hershfield Limited tendered the work on behalf of Toronto Parking Authority to five (5) pre-qualified general contractors on April, 2018. The call closed on May 17, 2018 and four (4) bids were received and considered as listed below in the ascending order (amounts shown not including HST). Table 1 - Summary of Bids Received (net of applicable taxes) General Contractors Amount Percentage General Sprinklers Inc. $599,000.00 100 Classic Fire Protection Inc. $620,000.00 104 Paul and Douglas Automatic Sprinklers Ltd. $649,000.00 108 Superior Sprinkler Co. Ltd. $659,000.00 110 Forest City Fire Protection No Bid

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Granted authority to the Acting President, Toronto Parking Authority, to award the Contract for the Fire Alarm and Sprinkler System Upgrades for Carparks 42 and 111, located at 91 Via Italia and 74 Clinton Street respectively, in the amount of $599,000.00 plus $26,000.00 as a contingency allowance, being the sum total amount of $625,000.00 net of all taxes and charges, to General Sprinklers Inc., having submitted the lowest compliant bid and meeting all specifications in conformance with the tender requirements.
